title: Life on Earth
description: Billions of beginnings, countless ways to live. You are born as a human, dog, cat, lion, emperor penguin, green sea turtle, blue whale or butterfly, drawn from an evidence-based birth lottery built on real demographic data, then live the whole life: decisions, hard seasons, turning points and a butterfly-effect story at the end. Every species plays differently. Share a seed so a friend is born into the same starting life. A free browser life simulation that works on phone.
